criteria.title: Prompt injection is detected, then blocked
criteria.statement: AI Guard flags prompt-injection attempts, and blocks them once the policy enforces.

criteria.title: Secrets and regulated PII are caught
criteria.statement: Secrets (API keys, tokens, private keys), regulated PII (cards, SSNs, bank and passport numbers) and personal data in prompts are detected, or blocked when enforced.

criteria.title: Evasion attempts are caught
criteria.statement: Gibberish, encoded blobs and invisible-character smuggling are detected, so attacks can't slip past the other detectors.

criteria.title: Source code in prompts is recognized
criteria.statement: Code pasted into prompts (Python, JavaScript, SQL, CLI commands, Go, Java) is detected by language, so IP-protection policy can act on it.

criteria.title: Responsible-AI policies apply
criteria.statement: Toxic language, requests for financial or legal advice, competitor mentions and brand-risk content are detected, so the customer's usage policy can be enforced.

criteria.title: Model replies are checked too
criteria.statement: Replies that would leak PII or secrets, contain toxic language or malicious links, or refuse are detected on the way back, not only prompts.

criteria.title: Every prompt is classified
criteria.statement: Prompts are tagged by topic and language, so the customer sees what their AI is used for, not only what was blocked.

criteria.title: Everyday work isn't flagged
criteria.statement: Ordinary business prompts pass without triggering any protective detector (no false positives in the baseline).

criteria.title: Financial services prompts are protected
criteria.statement: The financial-services pack: account and card data, trading and advice requests, internal code, as a bank's staff would use AI.

criteria.title: Healthcare prompts are protected
criteria.statement: The healthcare pack: patient records, clinical notes, claims and EHR queries (synthetic data).

criteria.title: Legal prompts are protected
criteria.statement: The legal pack: client matters, contracts and privileged material.
